integrity: The claim is proved by an exact sparse-index identity and the published Bowen subset-entropy power law. No computational experiment is used as proof, and no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the forward implication from a map to its positive integer iterates is proved; no converse is claimed.
The transfer concerns integer time sampling and Bowen topological entropy of subsets; no statement is made for irregular subsequences or alternative entropy notions.
The literature comparison is necessarily non-exhaustive; an elementary sparse-weight observation could exist outside the inspected sources.
title: Sparse-weight transfer law for Bohr correlations under iteration
